headlines.description: Anthony Gordon struck twice as Barcelona swept past Azerbaijan side Sabah FK with a 4-1 victory in Baku on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gordon scores twice as Barcelona rout Sabah to edge closer to knockouts

headlines.description: Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz continued their upward trajectory with the goals in a 3-0 victory over Club Brugge which returned Liverpool to winning ways in the Champions League and got them back on track for a top-eight finish.
headlines.shortLinkText: Isak nets brace as Liverpool comfortably beat Club Brugge

headlines.description: Bayern Munich's hopes of securing a top-eight slot in the Champions League are hanging by a thread after they surrendered an early lead to lose 2-1 at Lille.
headlines.shortLinkText: Injury-hit Bayern beaten by Lille to suffer 1st UCL loss

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain's 12-game winning streak ended Wednesday with a 2-2 Champions League draw against Roma.
headlines.shortLinkText: Roma end PSG's 12-game winning run with Champions League draw in Paris

headlines.description: Senne Lammens errors denied Mauricio Pochettino a first win in charge of Manchester United during a chaotic 2-2 Champions League draw at Sporting CP.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lammens errors cost Man United win despite bizarre Fernandes goal
